The microstructure images, the compositions and the crystal structures of the constituent phases were measured by SEM (scanning electron microscopy, JSM-6480LV), EPMA (electron probe microanalysis, GEOLJXA-8230) and XRD (X-ray diffraction, STOFDARMSTADT-STOE/2, 3 KW), respectively.

The starting experimental materials Nb and V are of the purity of 99.99% from Trillion Metals Co. Ltd. The samples with a weight of 5 g were melted in the arc furnace which was vacuumed at first and then filled with high purity argon. When the sample was prepared, the sponge titanium was used as an oxygen inhalant. The nominal compositions of all of the prepared samples as well as the weight losses after smelting are listed in Table 1.
